reason: A browser-only DSH Web plugin for keyboard-driven session switching, navigation, pinning, session actions, and shortcut configuration through an interface panel.

summaries.zh: 通过可自定义的键盘快捷键和面板，帮助用户在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中切换、导航、固定及管理会话。
summaries.en: Provides customizable keyboard shortcuts and a control panel for switching, navigating, pinning, and managing sessions in DeepSeek Harness Web.

capabilities: Registers configurable keyboard shortcuts in the DSH Web interface
Switches, creates, archives, and renames sessions through DSH services
Reads rendered session-sidebar state and DSH session, workspace, and layout services
Stores shortcut bindings and pinned-session mappings in browser localStorage
Adds and removes a keyboard-control panel and related interface elements
